description: A declaration whose defaults provably break its invariant (start 5 > end 1): E-WRITE-INVARIANT at the declaration — its shared instance and `reset` target would be invalid.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rule 9: "A write that provably breaks an invariant is the compile error E-WRITE-INVARIANT … the declaration's own defaults (its shared instance and `reset` target would be invalid — the error is at the declaration)".
